title: Evaluation policy, generation 1
description: The maintained input an evaluator reads before it judges anything. It is fixed before execution so that no check is chosen after a result is seen. This generation is Tier 0 only, which is why it admits exactly the two check classes Tier 0 owns, completeness and correctness. A canonical performance claim, a relative comparison against a baseline, a qualification result, trusted provenance, and a promotion are absent from the grammar rather than forbidden by convention, so a policy cannot state one at all. The policy carries bounds; it performs no comparison and reaches no verdict.

tier.description: Tier 0 is the only admitted value at this generation. A higher tier needs evidence this gate cannot produce, so admitting its spelling would be a claim with nothing behind it.

metricRegistryGeneration.description: Which registry generation every entry below is written against. A policy read against a different generation is not a weaker match; it is a different set of quantities.

policyKey.description: This entry's stable name, unique within the policy generation.

checkClass.description: Tier 0 owns completeness and correctness feedback. An absolute objective and a regression are absent deliberately: both need compatible trusted evidence from a qualified cell, and neither exists at this gate.

metricGeneration.description: The other half of the bound metric's identity. A policy binds one exact metric generation and never a metric name alone.

comparison.description: Absolute forms only. A ratio, a delta, or a comparison against a baseline is a relative claim and does not exist in this grammar.

bound.description: An integer paired with an explicit scale. No float, exponent form, NaN, infinity, or negative zero, exactly as SPEC-0017 requires of every value in a canonical record.
